# AresPrism

Local LaTeX editor and compiler. Local Zotero (zotero.sqlite), optional AI agents, simple UI, Git version snapshots.
Install on a Mac for the user: follow docs/ares/agent-install.md exactly.
Human install guides: docs/ares/install-zh.md, docs/ares/install-en.md, docs/ares/install-ko.md
Do not overwrite /Applications/ClaudePrism.app. Do not build from source unless asked.
GitHub: https://github.com/Ares960826/AresPrism
